basics.name: Aarav Sharma
basics.title: React Native Developer
basics.summary: React Native developer with 4 years of experience building and shipping cross-platform mobile apps for fintech and e-commerce products.

bullets.text: Led development of a React Native payments app used by 500K+ users across Android and iOS.
Reduced app startup time by 35% by lazy-loading modules and optimizing Redux store initialization.
Integrated biometric authentication (FaceID and Fingerprint) compliant with RBI regulations.
Built offline-first transaction sync using WatermelonDB and SQLite, reducing failed payment retries by 40%.
Mentored 3 junior developers and established automated PR testing via GitHub Actions and Jest.
Engineered core e-commerce features including live cart updates, product catalog, and push notifications.
Achieved 60 FPS animations on low-end Android devices using React Native Reanimated 2.
Integrated Razorpay and Paytm payment SDKs, processing over 50,000 daily orders.
Decreased app bundle size by 28% using ProGuard and Hermes engine optimizations.
